1355: def content_digest(entry: Mapping[str, Any], members: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] = ()) -> str:
1356:     """What a decision binds to: the entry as the owner reads it and, for an event, its rows.
1357: 
1358:     Roster-derived only -- questions, options, both sides' sealed names and ids, the
1359:     relation or basis, dates and records -- so a replay or effect refresh stales nothing,
1360:     and a change to another row leaves this one's decision current.

1363:     def owner_view(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1364:         return {key: value for key, value in item.items() if key not in _OUTSIDE_CONTENT}
1365: 
1366:     return _digest({"entry": owner_view(entry), "members": [owner_view(member) for member in members]})

1369: def _canonical_json_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:

1373: def _digest(value: Any) -> str:
1374:     return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json_bytes(value)).hexdigest()
